detail.longDescription: I’m building a production application that needs to call multiple AI models — GPT-6 for general chat, Gemini 4 Argon for long-context summarization, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash for cost-sensitive batch jobs, and Claude for code generation. Right now each provider has its own SDK, its own API key management, its own error handling, and its own billing. Every time I want to A/B test a new model or switch providers because of a pricing change, I end up touching service code. I’ve tried writing a thin adapter layer myself but it keeps growing into a mini-framework (retry logic, rate limiting, fallback chains, cost tracking…). Is there an established pattern or tool that lets you: Use one API interface (ideally OpenAI-compatible) to reach multiple model providers Switch models by changing a single parameter, not rewriting code Handle failover, retries, and caching at the gateway level rather than in application code Looking for practical solutions, not just architectural advice.
